videos.title: Deadliest Catch
videos.description: Time Bandit heads into False Pass to a crab offloading spot. But in the midst of storms and sand bars they're close to sinking. Can they make it through safely.

videos.title: Deadliest Catch
videos.description: On the Northwestern it's Edgar's birthday, and skipper Sig is worried about his advancing age. And, most of the fleet have to battle with deadly ice.

videos.title: Deadliest Catch
videos.description: On the Northwestern, the exhausted crew struggles to keep up with Captain Sig's maniacal pace - and deckhand, Jake Anderson, pays the price in blood.

videos.description: A distress call is issued when a man on a vessel suffers a heart attack and the coastguard attempts a dramatic rescue in huge seas, with low fuel and low visibility.

videos.description: In Australia's last travelling boxing tent, JC's boxing skills are put to the test. Plus, Rod and JC team up with opal mining matriarch, Sue White.

videos.description: Patrick and Kirsty unearth a giant million-dollar Amethyst cluster, while Pete and Kyle struggle to extract extremely fragile and rare Crocoite crystals.

videos.description: Patrick faces extreme temperatures to recover Australia's biggest-ever, million-dollar Amethyst cluster. In contrast, Pete and Kyle struggle in frigid conditions.

videos.description: Patrick and Kirsty search for rare Aquamarine crystals on their remote Queensland lease. Plus, Frankie & Ebriony face off against wild pigs and dingoes.

videos.description: The Victoria Diggers' desperately fight for survival, but they may have stumbled across a monster nugget. The Gold Gypsies fend off deadly snakes during their search.

videos.description: The Gold Gypsies hunt for nuggets in ancient mine shafts and Greg discovers a rare meteorite. The Mahoneys chase for more gold using Ted's granddad's treasure map.

videos.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
videos.description: The Mahoneys look for gold in one of the world's most remote regions. Meanwhile, the Victorian Diggers may have stumbled across millions of dollars' worth of gold.

videos.description: The Camaro build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialled in. Dave has second thoughts about the colour combination.

videos.title: Kindig Customs
videos.description: Dave finally realises one of his dreams by opening the Kindig Academy. To celebrate, the team throws a car show with a friendly competition.

videos.title: Junkyard Empire
videos.description: Andy's vision for big ideas leads to opportunity for the shop. If he achieves the build, he could secure years of future business - with a bit help from his dad.

videos.title: Junkyard Empire
videos.description: Andy thinks he's got an easy new way to make money - selling tricked out golf carts to his Dad's buddies. But when he tries to build one, it's harder than he thought.

videos.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
videos.description: A major workshop re-organisation is underway as Richard pushes the Smallest Cog to clinch their most important restoration yet.

videos.title: Richard Hammond's Workshop
videos.description: Richard brings in a business consultant to make the Workshop more efficient. An invitation to Goodwood re-ignites Richard's passion for Cog Race Team.

videos.description: Having fallen in love with an old '78 Chevy K20 as a teenager, a farm girl knew she had to get it. But time and storage have taken their toll.

videos.description: A rare '70 'Cuda convertible has been sitting for over 10 years. The team help its cancer-surviving owner get this Mopar monster back on the road.

videos.description: Jeremy explores an incredible underwater discovery in the Arctic. Plus, he reveals details of a high-speed chase between a narco sub and the US Coast Guard.
